mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. (FEDFUNDS decline -> SPX positive)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 5.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals strong labor conditions that boost corporate profits and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and business investment, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a weakening in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy response to inflation, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong industrial growth regime (INDPRO > 100.0), a sustained increase in industrial production signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
